# cpanel_ssl_keys (Data Source)

Reads the complete stored SSL key metadata inventory without exposing modulus values, ECDSA public parameters, or private-key material.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_ssl_keys" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `keys` (Attributes List) The stored SSL keys sorted by cPanel identifier. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Read-Only:

- `created` (Number) The creation time as a Unix timestamp.
- `ecdsa_curve_name` (String) The ECDSA curve name, or `null` when not applicable.
- `friendly_name` (String) The key display name.
- `id` (String) The key identifier assigned by cPanel.
- `key_algorithm` (String) The public-key algorithm, when reported.
- `modulus_length` (Number) The RSA modulus length, or `null` when not applicable.
